title.zh: 将泰雅巴斯省的Mogpog现有市镇与Boac市镇合并，并将市镇政府所在地设于现有Boac市镇的法案
title.en: AN ACT CONSOLIDATING THE PRESENT MUNICIPALITY OF MOGPOG WITH THE MUNICIPALITY OF BOAC, BOTH IN THE PROVINCE OF TAYABAS, WITH THE SEAT OF MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT AT THE PRESENT MUNICIPALITY OF BOAC.
title.orig: AN ACT CONSOLIDATING THE PRESENT MUNICIPALITY OF MOGPOG WITH THE MUNICIPALITY OF BOAC, BOTH IN THE PROVINCE OF TAYABAS, WITH THE SEAT OF MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT AT THE PRESENT MUNICIPALITY OF BOAC.
title.vi: Luật sáp nhập đô thị Mogpog hiện nay với đô thị Boac, cùng thuộc tỉnh Tayabas, đặt trụ sở chính quyền tại đô thị Boac hiện nay
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติรวมเทศบาล Mogpog ปัจจุบันเข้ากับเทศบาล Boac ในจังหวัด Tayabas โดยให้ที่ตั้งรัฐบาลเทศบาลอยู่ที่เทศบาล Boac ปัจจุบัน
title.id: Undang-Undang menggabungkan munisipalitas Mogpog saat ini dengan munisipalitas Boac di Provinsi Tayabas, dengan pusat pemerintahan di munisipalitas Boac saat ini
title.ms: Akta menggabungkan perbandaran Mogpog yang sedia ada dengan perbandaran Boac di wilayah Tayabas, dengan pusat kerajaan perbandaran di Boac yang sedia ada

text.en:
The municipality of Mogpog, in the Province of Tayabas, is hereby annexed to and consolidated
with the municipality of Boac, in the same province, with the seat of municipal government at the present
municipality of Boac.

The municipal elections in Boac in December, nineteen hundred and four, shall be held in
accordance with the rules contained in Act Numbered Seven hundred and thirty, as amended by Act
Numbered Nine hundred and twenty-eight. When the new municipal officials shall have been elected and
shall have qualified, present organization of each of the municipalities mentioned in section one of this Act
shall be thereby abolished, and all offices held by virtue of their present organization shall be vacant and
abolished, so that all the present municipal officials shall cease to hold office as soon as the new officials
shall have taken the oath of office. Until the officials elected for the new municipality of Bono, as described
in section one, shall have qualified, the present organization of the existing municipalities shall continue.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, July 26, 1904.
